source_scope: Round 48 sequential review of printed Chapters 892–901. Cumulative item CSV v4.8; baseline JSON remains v4.6 plus append-only v4.7 and v4.8 addenda. Fixed schedule unchanged.

confirmed_outcomes.event: Dream-shop exchanges confirmed: 1,000,000 Dream Shards for Mosin Pillar Legendary blueprint; 1,500,000 for Lord Temple Legendary blueprint; 2,250,000 for Divine Power Shards x45. The two upgrades begin immediately from level-30 buildings, with no materials/workers; durations 728h35m and 965h41m. Dream-library outcomes: Andrew brings back level-150 Epic Nature's Gift necklace (+40% Nature skill damage/effect); Francesca brings back one-third Eldritch Codex with dozens of recipes and two Legendary recipes; Xierda awakens Spider Emperor Web; Binglan learns Dragon God Swordsmanship.

Xierda uses the already-held Blood Source Godfire and 190 Divine Shards; system states she had naturally restored 117 divine power and consumes 200 points to activate Poison Blood. Breakthrough to Half-God succeeds; no new Blood Godfire or shard receipt.
Territory report confirms 472 Return Scrolls produced and received; city and farming data are reports, not item receipts.
One Demi-God Dralamam Light Cannon is completed and reported; source says four units' worth of materials were prepared and three more are ordered within one month. The latter three are plans only.

Harold completes one Legendary Night-Rhino King Armor from existing Legendary giant-rhino hide and Night Lionheart Gem; it is bound to Sarah. 200+ Gold Scurmice stones and one Rainbow Crystal are assigned to later batch enhancement; quantities consumed are not specified here.
Roxie joins the territory at level 151; system reports population +10, prosperity +1500, Human Fortune +5000 (reversible if she leaves/dies). Exact gift receipt: Divine Power Shards x439.

Five existing Legendary equipment pieces are raised to level 150; total 38 Gold Scurmice stones used (4 each for Moon Goddess Staff and Starfall Codex; 10 each for the other three). Staff and Starfall Codex are explicitly named; remaining three include Lich Frost Soul Robe, Lich Ice Bone Leggings, Demon Codex. This is enhancement of existing items, not five new item identities.
Expedition departs for Eternal Frozen Sea; church sages seek the Golden Dragon Horn and carry a Church Emblem for escape. Horn is not retrieved in this chapter.

The party discovers Eternal Frozen Sea at -78C; exploration XP +500,000 and reputation +1,000. Chapter establishes Ice Ghouls/Icefield Giant context; no item reward, chest opening, or confirmed loot receipt in the reviewed chapter.

non_receipts: Do not count the Chapter 892 aggregate Divine Shard balance (395) as an additional receipt; it is a snapshot.
Blood Source Godfire is pre-existing and consumed by Xierda; 190 shards are a stated contribution and 200 divine-power points are consumed, not received.
Dream-library skill/trait/codex outcomes are recorded as source findings, but are not separate physical-item receipts unless a named item is explicitly described.
Three additional Dralamam Light Cannons are ordered, not completed. The four-unit material preparation is not a receipt.

Gold Scurmice stones and Rainbow Crystals in Ch897 are pre-existing inventory; the precise number actually consumed during batch enhancement is only provided for the 38 stones in Ch899. Do not infer Rainbow Crystal use or catalog it as a new receipt.
Ch900 Golden Dragon Horn is a target; not acquired. Church Emblem is already-held/used as an escape option, no new receipt.
No chest-opening or loot table is documented in Ch892–901. Do not extrapolate rewards from the expedition, fortress reports, or named treasure objective.
